collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DISABILITY AND HUMAN DIVERSITY (DIV-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Disabled villagers, chronic illness and every kind of body, skin, hair and face: wheelchairs with real wheels, crutches, canes, ear trumpets, signs and lenses made from island materials; good days and hard days; competence, humor and opinions. Sometimes the difference is the story. Often it's just part of the scenery.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult and another adult; in the story (name1) has seizures sometimes)

collection.description: A villager has a seizure in the garden, and a friend knows what to do: walk them home after, or let them rest where they are.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has seizures now and then, and has done since (subject.he/she) was small. Everyone who works with (subject.him/her) knows what to do: move things out of the way, put something soft under (subject.his/her) head, stay close, don't hold (subject.him/her) down, wait. Today, in the garden, it happens. (friend) does exactly that, and it passes, as it usually does. Afterward, (subject) is very tired and a little confused, and slowly comes back to (subject.him/her)self.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: When (subject) is ready, (friend) offers an arm, and (subject) takes it. They walk home slowly. (subject) sleeps for the rest of the afternoon. In the evening (subject.he/she) is out at the fire again, a bit quiet, eating a large dinner. "Thanks," (subject.he/she) says to (friend). "You did that well." (friend) shrugs, but (friend.he/she) looks pleased.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) doesn't want to move yet. (friend) fetches water and a mat, puts up a palm frond for shade, and goes back to weeding nearby, close enough to hear. After a long rest, (subject) sits up. "Did I squash the beans?" (subject.He/she) did, a few. "They'll grow back," says (friend). "So will I," says (subject), and gets back to work the next day.
